feature.title: Deepgram Nova-3 as a transcription provider
feature.problem: Parley can only transcribe through Groq's Whisper. Someone who already pays for Deepgram, or who wants Nova-3's keyterm prompting for jargon-heavy dictation, has no way to use it. This feature adds Deepgram Nova-3 as a second speech-to-text provider next to Groq. The Overview's Transcription row gains a provider choice (Whisper (Groq) / Deepgram Nova-3) and a key form for whichever is selected. Groq stays the default, so existing users see no change. Readiness and the gesture block mean “the selected provider has a key”. Deepgram gets the dictionary words as keyterms, not Whisper's prose prompt. Frame note: the settings window is not PageShell, so the archetype below is illustrative and not probe-enforced, as in parley-007 to parley-010.
nonGoals: A provider choice in the first-run flow — it stays Groq-only; Deepgram is chosen on the Overview.
Streaming (websocket) transcription — the orb still sends one recording after release.
Languages other than English, or a model picker beyond Nova-3.
Falling back to the other provider when one fails.

states.loading: Settings resolve before the shell mounts, as today. While a provider switch is saving, the SegmentedControl is disabled.
states.empty: The selected provider has no key: the row badge reads Missing, the title reads Finish setup, and that provider's key form opens.
states.error: A rejected key shows the provider's message (“Invalid API key”) beside the button. A failed switch shows a red Alert under the row. A failed dictation names the provider on the pill (“Deepgram error”).
states.success: Saving a key closes the form and the badge flips to Stored. Switching to a provider that already has a key keeps Parley ready at once.

components.control: SegmentedControl (Whisper (Groq) / Deepgram Nova-3) inside the Transcription row's Collapse, above the key form
components.why: Two mutually exclusive options that are both visible at once, and the choice applies immediately. That is what SegmentedControl is for.
components.rejected: Select (hides the second option behind a click), Radio group (heavier, and reads as a form to submit)

components.control: The existing ApiKeySection, relabelled per provider (Groq API key / Deepgram API key)
components.why: The same test-then-save form and messages the Groq key already uses. Only the label, placeholder and mutation change.
components.rejected: Two always-visible key forms (one of them is irrelevant to the selected provider)
